translations.web: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city: and Jotham his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in the City of David. And his son Jotham reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: So Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
